hooks.name: guard-web-fetch
hooks.description: Blocks the web_fetch tool when the address holds a secret (key or token), a canary token, or a value from a .env file of this project, plain, percent-encoded, base64 or split. A fetch sends its address to another computer. Exit code 2 blocks the fetch; the reason names the kind of value and the host, never the value. Unparsable input is allowed. Runs through scripts/kiro-hook.sh because Kiro gives hook commands a PATH without Node.
